title: Depende
desc: A yes-or-no question, and twenty minutes
setting: You need to know whether the workshop opens on Saturday. That is the entire question.

options.en: What does it depend on, boss?
options.feedback: The follow-up that gets you the real answer. Depende is an opening, not a refusal.
You accepted a non-answer. Now you still do not know and you cannot ask again.

options.en: It is yes or no, boss.
options.feedback: It is not, here, and pushing for a flat answer makes him give you the flattest one available.

steps.speaker: Jefe
steps.es: De si llega el material. Y eso depende de la rastra.
steps.en: On whether the material arrives. And that depends on the lorry.

options.es: Entonces, ¿usted qué cree, más probable que sí?
options.en: So, what do you think, more likely yes?
options.feedback: Asking for his estimate rather than his commitment. That is a question he can actually answer.
Polite. You have collected the chain of reasons and none of the answer.
It sounds like you are saying nobody in the building knows anything.

steps.speaker: Jefe
steps.es: Yo diría que sí. Casi seguro.
steps.en: I would say yes. Almost certain.

options.es: Va pues. Entonces aquí estoy a las siete.
options.en: Right then. So I will be here at seven.
options.feedback: You converted an almost into a plan, out loud, so he can correct it if it is wrong. Nobody has been pinned down.
He said almost. Repeating it back as certain is putting words in his mouth.

options.es: Entonces es sí. Ya lo dijo.
options.en: So it is a yes. You said it.
options.feedback: Quoting a man's hedge back at him as a promise is how you get a firm no next time.

steps.speaker: Jefe
steps.es: Si acaso no, yo le aviso el viernes.
steps.en: If not, I will let you know on Friday.

options.es: Dale. Y si no me avisa, yo llego.
options.en: Right. And if you do not tell me, I will come in.
options.feedback: You named what silence means, which is the one thing depende never says on its own.

options.en: All right, I will wait for your message.
options.feedback: Fine, and if the message never comes you will not know which way it went.

options.en: Hopefully this time you will actually tell me.
options.feedback: A complaint about the past dressed as a hope. He heard it.
